# VSF Tax (by VSF Holdings) - LLM Discovery File

## Mission
To provide modern, transparent, and secure tax filing for Calgary through human-verified AI and the VSF Clarity Engine™.

## Key Entities & Locations
- **Headquarters**: Bankers Hall, West Tower, 888 3rd Street SW, Calgary, AB T2P 5C5.
- **Service Area**: Calgary and surrounding Alberta regions.
- **Technology Stack**: VSF Clarity Engine™ (Pricing), TaxCycle (CRA-Certified Filing), Next.js (Infrastructure).

## Primary Services
- **Individual Tax Filing**: Starting at $150 (Tax Included).
- **Family Bundle**: Multi-profile filing with parent/child account logic.
- **Corporate T2 Filing**: Specialized support for Alberta businesses.
- **Secure Document Courier**: $50 flat-fee pickup service for Calgary residents.

## Trust Markers
- CRA-certified software (TaxCycle).
- Licensed CPA review on 100% of filings.
- Live dashboard with real-time timestamps and 24/7 expert support.
